releaseNotes:
• One unified player everywhere — HEVC / 4K now plays smoothly (a VLC engine kicks in automatically when your phone needs it, with the exact same controls)
• Auto Bangla subtitle on EVERY server — movies & series
• Hindi audio plays by default on dual-audio titles
• YouTube fallback — if a movie/natok isn't on our servers, it now plays from YouTube automatically
• Live TV fixed — thousands of channels are back; a channel that won't play now shows Next / Retry / Previous instead of getting stuck, and the list remembers your place when you go back
• Downloads show file size, language & format in a cleaner list
• Check for updates right inside Settings → App update
• Offline downloads of HEVC files now play too
• Many speed & stability fixes

Thank you for your support!
